name: LLMBackend
description: Configuration for an LLM provider backend in AgentGateway, defining the target model, authentication, and routing parameters.

name.description: Unique name for this LLM backend.

provider.description: The LLM provider for this backend.

model.description: The model identifier to use for requests.

alias.description: Optional alias exposed to clients instead of the actual model name.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for the LLM provider API endpoint.

secretRef.description: Reference to a secret containing the API key.

weight.description: Load balancing weight for this backend (higher means more traffic).

priority.description: Failover priority, lower values have higher priority.
